title: PM Modi Sanskrit Subhashita: Prime Minister Shares Verse on Courage and Steadfastness
text:
New Delhi, India — August 20, 2026
PM Modi Sanskrit Subhashita has again drawn attention after Prime Minister Narendra Modi shared a Sanskrit verse on social media platform X on Thursday, emphasizing resilience, courage and the importance of maintaining enthusiasm even during difficult circumstances.
The Prime Minister posted the verse:
“आपत्काले च कष्टेऽपि नोत्साहस्त्यज्यते बुधैः। इति प्रबोधितस्तेन कथञ्चिद् दृढबुद्धिना।”
The message conveys that people of wisdom and firm resolve do not lose their enthusiasm even in times of crisis and hardship. The verse presents perseverance and mental steadiness as qualities that help individuals face adversity without surrendering hope or determination.
PM Modi’s Thursday Message Focuses on Courage in Crisis The latest Subhashita centers on the idea that difficult situations should not weaken a person’s resolve.
Its broader message is that those with a steady mind and clear judgment continue to act with confidence even when circumstances become challenging.
By sharing the verse, PM Modi continued a series of Sanskrit messages posted over recent days, each focusing on a different personal or ethical value.
The Thursday post highlighted courage, perseverance and emotional resilience .
Wednesday’s Verse Focused on Service and Welfare A day earlier, Modi shared another Sanskrit Subhashita emphasizing service to others and actions that promote welfare.
The verse read:
“एतावज्जन्मसाफल्यं देहिनामिह देहिषु। प्राणैरर्थैर्धिया वाचा श्रेय एवाचरेत्सदा॥”
Its meaning centers on the idea that human life becomes meaningful when people use their physical strength, wealth, intellect and speech for the benefit of others.
The message encouraged acts of service and public good, presenting selfless action as an important measure of a meaningful life.
Tuesday’s Message Highlighted Self-Respect and Courage On Tuesday, PM Modi had shared another Sanskrit verse:
“उद्यच्छेदेव न नमेदुद्यमो ह्येव पौरुषम्। अप्यपर्वणि भज्येत न नमत्वेव कस्यचित्॥”
The message emphasized self-respect, courage and the importance of standing firmly by one’s principles.
Its central idea is that true strength lies in refusing to compromise one’s values under pressure and in maintaining dignity even during adversity.
The verse also stresses determination and personal integrity as essential elements of character.
A Series Built Around Traditional Wisdom The Prime Minister’s recent posts have followed a clear thematic pattern.
Tuesday’s verse emphasized self-respect and courage .
Wednesday’s Subhashita focused on service, welfare and helping others .
Thursday’s message highlighted resilience and maintaining enthusiasm during hardship .
Together, the three verses present a sequence of traditional Sanskrit teachings centered on personal character, social responsibility and mental strength.
Why Sanskrit Subhashitas Carry Cultural Significance Subhashitas are short Sanskrit verses traditionally used to convey ethical teachings, practical wisdom and values related to everyday life.
The term broadly refers to a “well-spoken” or “wise saying.”
Such verses frequently address themes including discipline, friendship, knowledge, humility, courage, duty and public welfare.
Because they condense wider philosophical ideas into memorable lines, Subhashitas have long been used in education and cultural traditions across India.
PM Modi Uses Social Media to Share Traditional Messages Prime Minister PM Modi regularly uses social media to communicate political, cultural and personal messages.
The recent series of Sanskrit verses has placed greater emphasis on classical Indian wisdom and moral teachings.
Rather than focusing on a specific government announcement, Thursday’s post carried a broader motivational message: hardship should not lead to the loss of enthusiasm or determination .
That theme also gives the verse wider relevance beyond politics, particularly for people facing professional, personal or social challenges.
The Core Message: Do Not Lose Resolve During Difficult Times The central takeaway from the latest PM Modi Sanskrit Subhashita is simple but direct.
Challenges and setbacks are unavoidable, but wisdom lies in maintaining determination when conditions become difficult.
The verse suggests that courage is not merely the absence of hardship. Instead, it is the ability to continue acting with purpose and enthusiasm despite hardship.
With Thursday’s post, PM Modi continued a sequence of Sanskrit messages emphasizing perseverance, social responsibility, dignity and strength of character.
